class: a cleanup that pruned the repository's worktree registry, so every registration whose folder it could not see was dropped, other tools' included
caught_by: the engine removes only the base worktree it created, by name: git worktree remove --force --force on a folder whose unique name is its registration's, then the folder itself, and nothing prunes. A static test fails on a worktree prune in any script or source file under plugins/, prime-agent/ and scripts/
missed_by: a git worktree prune after every base run, against the operator's standing rule that nothing prunes; a prune that cannot read a protected folder can drop a registration that is still live

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
